line.glass-road.a-beetle-surveyor-he-nev: A beetle surveyor... he never made it home. Look at what he carried.
line.glass-road.a-tunnel-this-far-from: A tunnel? This far from any nest?
line.glass-road.amber-under-those-thorns: Amber under those thorns. Clear the briars and we can raise a second nest here.
line.glass-road.an-old-toll-house-the: An old toll house. The beetles would charge the rain to cross their road.
line.glass-road.and-when-they-will-not: And when they will not share it?
line.glass-road.ants-inside-my-walls-sea: Ants inside my walls? Seal the yard! Wake the lodge!
line.glass-road.careful-that-is-the-holl: Careful. That is the Hollow Stag. Older than the road, older than any of us.
line.glass-road.carts-on-the-road-majest: Carts on the road, Majesty. The beetles feed that station from the west. Cut the supply and the glass goes thirsty.
line.glass-road.coilkeeper-vosk-i-know-w: Coilkeeper Vosk. I know what you are, little queen. Your broods drink the light raw, and it eats them from the inside.
line.glass-road.fine-fine-take-this-and: Fine, fine. Take this, and don't tell the Coilkeeper you saw me.
line.glass-road.glass-is-not-for-those: Glass is not for those who drink.
line.glass-road.hornwatch-towers-beetle-: Hornwatch towers. Beetle guns never tire. Bring the whole column, not a handful.
line.glass-road.it-runs-under-the-road: It runs under the road and comes up behind their west wall. They have forgotten it was ever dug.
line.glass-road.it-s-warm-it-hums: It's warm. It hums... like something breathing in its sleep.
line.glass-road.keeper-of-the-glass-i: Keeper of the glass! I am Aurelith, Queen of the ants. I would speak with you.
line.glass-road.majesty-that-rubble-that: Majesty, that rubble. That's ant work. Old ant work.
line.glass-road.majesty-your-mother-set-: Majesty. Your mother set me to hold the end of this road. I hear her daughter means to walk it.
line.glass-road.now-we-can-learn-what: Now we can learn what it is.
line.glass-road.our-grandmothers-dug-tow: Our grandmothers dug toward the glass long before the beetles paved over it. Break it open.
line.glass-road.salves-flasks-sealed-jar: Salves, flasks, sealed jars... they live well, these beetles.
line.glass-road.take-it-then-drink-from: Take it, then. Drink from it. And see what answers.
line.glass-road.that-s-one-cart-that: That's one cart that won't reach the glass.
line.glass-road.the-beetles-keep-substan: The beetles keep substance in glass, General, and it never changes them. I mean to learn how.
line.glass-road.the-condenser-is-behind-: The condenser is behind that wall. Break their Great Bastion and the station is ours.
line.glass-road.the-gate-is-down-majesty: The gate is down, Majesty! Now the lodge comes out to meet us.
line.glass-road.the-road-runs-north-of: The road runs north of the camp. Its outposts will not let us pass quietly.
line.glass-road.then-i-will-take-it: Then I will take it. No brood of ours will rot in the dark again.
line.glass-road.then-my-mandibles-are-yo: ...Then my mandibles are yours, my Queen.
line.glass-road.then-teach-us-your-glass: Then teach us your glass, and they will never drink again.
line.glass-road.they-keep-a-condenser-at: They keep a condenser at the far end of the road. Whatever they know is in that machine.
line.glass-road.they-re-opening-the-lodg: They're opening the lodge, Majesty. Here they come.
line.glass-road.they-re-waking-the-lodge: They're waking the lodge behind that gate, Majesty. Break it, and they come out.
line.glass-road.three-caravans-the-stati: Three caravans. The station will feel that, Majesty.
line.glass-road.toads-in-the-bog-and: Toads in the bog... and something bottled under the reeds. Beetle-made.
line.glass-road.turn-your-column-around-: Turn your column around. The next ant on my road goes home in pieces.
line.glass-road.we-came-to-ask-coilkeepe: We came to ask, Coilkeeper. Now we take.
line.glass-road.wha-ants-i-wasn-t: Wha- ants?! I wasn't sleeping! I was listening to the boiler!
line.glass-road.your-mother-would-have-c: Your mother would have called it madness.
objective.glass-road.caravans.descriptio: Ambush three beetle supply caravans on the Glass Road: kill both carts of each.
objective.glass-road.caravans.title: Ambush the caravans
objective.glass-road.condenser.descripti: Break the beetle station (its Great Bastion) and bring Aurelith to the condenser.
objective.glass-road.condenser.title: Take the condenser
objective.glass-road.speak.description: Take the Glass Road to the beetle station and ask its keeper for the secret of the glass.
objective.glass-road.speak.title: Speak with the beetles
